description: List secrets in a GitHub repository or organization.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: The base URL for the GitHub API. Default: "https://api.github.com"

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: The GitHub username or organization name.

parameters.name: repository
parameters.description: The name of the repository. If not provided, the listing will be at organization level.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: The GitHub token used for authentication.

examples:
- name: List Github secret
  community.general.github_secrets_info:
    token: "{{ lookup('ansible.builtin.env', 'GITHUB_TOKEN') }}"
    repository: "ansible"
    organization: "ansible"

return_values.name: secrets
return_values.description: The list of currently existing secrets. Returned: success Sample: [{"created_at": "2026-01-11T23:19:00Z", "name": "ANSIBLE", "updated_at": "2026-02-15T22:18:16Z"}]

return_values.name: created_at
return_values.description: The date and time when the secret was created. Returned: success

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The name of the secret. Returned: success

return_values.name: updated_at
return_values.description: The date and time when the secret was last updated. Returned: success
